sources.citation: https://github.com/cyrils/renogy-bt — README.md logged request frames and characteristic UUIDs

transport: BLE GATT, not RS-485 — the same Modbus PDU is written whole into characteristic 0000ffd1-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb (service 0000ffd0) and the reply arrives as a notification on 0000fff1-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb (service 0000fff0). Slave address 0xFF, function codes 03 and 06. No baud rate, no serial framing, no inter-frame gap.

refutedOnReview: The protocol facts survive verification; the model list does not, and the claim is stated as a model-membership claim.  VERIFIED (both sources exist and say what is quoted, and I checked more than the claim offered): - Olen/solar-monitor plugins/SolarLink/__init__.py: DEVICE_ID=255, function_READ=3, function_WRITE=6; reads REG_ADDR 256 (7w), 263 (4w), 288 (3w), 57345 (33w); writes 266 for load on/off. Notify service/
gotchas: This is one dialect with srne-controller-v3 at the register level and a completely different transport. It cannot live inside an RS-485 driver — it needs a BLE central, GATT subscription, and reconnect handling. The family tag above is the closest of the six the catalogue defines; the honest description is 'Modbus PDU

The two crosschecking implementations are not equally on-topic. cyrils/renogy-bt is a Renogy library; its README says it 'might also work with other SRNE like devices'. Olen/solar-monitor targets SRNE directly (the SolarLink app is com.shuorigf, Shenzhen Shuori / SRNE) and its README asserts 'Renogy BT-1 uses the same

Neither implementation is covered by the SRNE vendor PDF. The PDF documents RS-232, two RS-485 pinouts and TTL, at 9600 8N1. It says nothing about Bluetooth, the GATT UUIDs, or the 0xFF-addressed framing. Everything transport-side here is reconstructed.

Slave address 0xFF is used, which the vendor doc (§2.2 remarks) describes as bypassing the configured device address — explicitly 'not suitable for multiple 485 bus access'. Fine for one module talking to one controller, and a reason the same module cannot be daisy-chained.
Olen reads 33 words starting at 0xE001, but the vendor doc marks 0xE001 write-only. Either the doc understates it or the module tolerates the read. Unverified either way.
unmappedReports: same set as srne-controller-v3, additionally the BLE device alias itself (BT-TH-xxxxxxxx), which is how the module is discovered and has no metric home
